why: BV-12's glucose knockouts run 3 generations, and the corpus fit's wildtype/basal exists at depths 1, 4 and 7 only. The survey reads a run's LAST generation, so a knockout at depth 3 has no depth-matched reference (tests/test_generation_depth.py fails on the live corpus). Two depth-3 wildtype/basal seeds are added; seeds 16 and 17 because 0 to 15 are taken at other depths and a seed directory holds one depth. The panel, the knockouts and the scoring are unchanged.
